In `worker/src/services/ai-dm.ts`, `askDM` (line 81) calls `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast` first. If that `ai.run()` throws, the `catch` retries with `@cf/mistral/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2-lora`; if that also throws, it immediately returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)`.

On success, the raw text goes to `parseAIResponse(raw, playerAction)`: it strips markdown fences, extracts the first `{...}` block, and runs `JSON.parse`. If the text is empty/non-string, no `{...}` block is found, or `JSON.parse` throws, it also returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)`.

`fallbackNarrative` builds a canned `AIDMResponse`: a generic narrative string (`"You attempt to {action}. The world shifts around you..."`), null/empty `gameStateChanges`, default `suggestedActions` (`['Look around', 'Proceed carefully', 'Listen for sounds', 'Rest a moment']`), and empty `diceRolls` — so the game always gets a valid, mechanically-neutral response even when both models fail or return malformed JSON.
